reviewHarnessNotes: Initial F:/Python/py39 interpreter lacked cryptography; rerun used bundled Python dependency runtime.

Initial generic JSON string serialization does not implement TUF canonical raw newline behavior in root public keys; corrected canonical encoder and reran all signature checks. These were review harness setup errors, not repository failures.

Initial all-archive-members raw equality predicate was broader than the report/source-code requirement. The one historical document line-ending difference was isolated, communicated and recorded rather than claiming full raw archive-to-commit equality.
